title: Zucchini Soup
description: A quick, light soup: grated zucchini simmered in tomato passata with garlic, finished with fresh herbs and grated Parmesan.

steps.heading: Garlic
steps.text: Heat the oil in a large saucepan and cook the garlic over high heat for 30 seconds, until just starting to brown.

steps.heading: Zucchini
steps.text: Add the zucchini and cook, stirring, for a couple of minutes.

steps.heading: Simmer
steps.text: Add the passata and 2 cups water and bring to a boil. Simmer for 7 to 8 minutes, until the zucchini is tender.

steps.heading: Finish
steps.text: Taste and season, then toss through the herbs. Serve with cheese grated over the top.
